• Pulizia dell'intera area operativa compresa la disinfezione delle stanze

• Buone condizioni fisiche e mentali
• Buona conoscenza orale e scritta della lingua tedesca (B1/B2) e competenze informatiche

Employee operating room and bed cleaning 80% Department of Real Estate & Operations, Facility Management Work location Grabs Job advertisement Your tasks and perspectives
• Cleaning of the entire operating area including disinfection of the rooms
• Special cleaning in accordance with specifications and hygiene regulations
• Preparation of the beds in the wards and completion of the associated work
• General cleaning of all rooms in the hospital in accordance with the cleaning concept HIGH
• Willingness to work on weekends What you bring to this position
• Several years of experience in cleaning in the healthcare sector, preferably with certificate of competency as a specialist in housekeeping
• Good physical and mental condition
• Good oral and written knowledge of German (B1/B2) as well as PC skills
• Clean, thorough and precise way of working
• Independent, flexible and reliable personality who enjoys working in a team Our offer to you
• Interesting and varied work in a family environment
• Future-oriented and innovative company
• Attractive employee benefits
• Employment according to cantonal guidelines Your application
• Entry on August 1st, 2026 or by appointment
• You can find out more about this exciting position from Ms. Livia Sieber, Housekeeping Group Manager, Telephone +41 81 772 57 09
• If you have any questions about the application process, please contact Ms. Anna Grenz, HR Business Partner, Telephone +41 71 494 24 55 About us Healthcare is our profession and our calling. As the largest employer in Eastern Switzerland, we are committed to offering our employees a diverse working environment. We promote individual development and thus make an active contribution to our shared future. We rely on team spirit, interdisciplinary collaboration and innovative solutions.
